description: Describe what you want to know in plain language and get back the services worth buying, with price, endpoint, free-sample link and the keywords that matched. A question with several parts, for example 'btc leverage and eurozone inflation', is split into topics and routed separately, and the picks are bundled with a total price. Routing only: nothing is called or purchased, and it matches keywords rather than interpreting the question. Start here when you do not yet know which services you need.

question.description: Your question or need in plain language, up to 300 characters, for example 'what can move bitcoin next, and when'.

name: edge_ask
title: Ask a question, get the services to buy
